name: Uriah
overview: Uriah was a male prophet who prophesied in the name of the LORD, as recorded in Jeremiah 26:20. While his tribal affiliation is not specified, his role as a messenger of God's word marks him as a significant figure in the prophetic tradition. No additional notes are provided about his life or ministry.
namesAndTitles: The name Uriah means 'y-h-v-h is [my] flame, light,' reflecting a theophoric element that acknowledges the LORD as a source of divine illumination. This proper name is noted in Jeremiah 26:20 and underscores the connection between his identity and God's presence.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records that Uriah was the father of Shemaiah, as explicitly stated in Jeremiah 26:20. Beyond this, no other family relationships are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Uriah's significance lies in his prophetic ministry, where he boldly spoke in the name of the LORD during a critical period. His mention in Jeremiah 26:20 highlights his role within the prophetic community and the challenges faced by those who faithfully delivered God's messages. His legacy is preserved through the acknowledgment of his prophetic work and his family line.
